predictor: July monthly mean Arctic sea-ice extent from NOAA/NSIDC Sea Ice Index passive-microwave satellites
target: Same-year September monthly mean Arctic sea-ice extent, not annual daily minimum
forecast_at: August 15, assuming monthly July values available by then; archive not historical publication proof
model: Expanding OLS: intercept, calendar-year linear trend, previous-year September extent, current July extent
comparators: Expanding OLS intercept + linear trend + previous September extent
training: First 20 eligible annual rows, previous September required; every subsequent complete target year through 2025 is chronological test
uncertainty: Paired circular 2-year block bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 20260927; RMSE reduction vs each baseline
gate: At least 5% lower RMSE and lower MAE than every baseline, strictly positive 95% paired RMSE-reduction interval against trend-plus-prior-year baseline
selection: One fixed July->September horizon, Arctic-wide extent target, no model or horizon search
limitations: Current revised archive hindcast, not first-release or prospective verification
Satellite target is same product at a future date; shipping capacity itself not evaluated
Economic and trading alpha not verified
